x: Jack Brown, Arthur Bruce, Len Adams and Ray Tooby all broke stage records, with Eddie Short also doing so but finding one better runner on the day in Ken Norris of Thames Valley.

However, we were still a minute behind the leaders due to a record breaking run by Adcocks of Coventry who reduced Ken Norris's 8 year old time by 16 seconds and took his club into a 22 sec. record lead over Derby with Portsmouth close behind.
Mimoun was beaten in the Jubilee race by Lucien Theys of Belgium but in 1954 at Birmingham he regained the title at the expense of Ken Norris.
